name: Mohamed Amzad Abdoel
notes: NDP member of parliament for Wanica (2010–2020) and parliamentary faction leader; appointed vice-chair of the Staatsraad in 2025.

name: Ronny Asabina
role: Member of De Nationale Assemblée; Chairman of BEP
affiliation: Broederschap en Eenheid in de Politiek
notes: BEP chairman and faction leader in DNA representing Brokopondo (2010–2015, 2020–present); economist and tax expert. Advocated taxing the wealthy over the working class and closing loopholes in the 1944 wealth tax.

name: Armand Zunder
notes: Prominent Surinamese economist, author and union leader; official spokesperson for union federation Ravaksur.

name: Raad van Vakcentrales in Suriname
notes: Suriname’s main trade union confederation (Ravaksur), uniting C-47, De Moederbond, PWO, CLO, BvL/FOLS and OSAV.

name: Broederschap en Eenheid in de Politiek
notes: Political party with 2 seats in De Nationale Assemblée (2020–2025).

name: Partij voor Recht en Ontwikkeling
notes: Surinamese reformist political party founded in 2018.

name: Roy Shyamnarain
notes: Prominent Surinamese fiscalist, managing director at Shyamnarain Associates and former tax inspector.

name: Carlo Jadnanansing
role: Jurist, former notary and legal scholar
notes: Surinamese jurist, notary and essayist; writes regular legal analyses and commentaries.

name: Patricia Etnel
notes: NPS member of parliament for Paramaribo (2015–2025); fiercely criticized government budget in 2023 for undercollecting wealth taxes from the super-rich while squeezing citizens.

name: Steven Debipersad
role: Chairman of the Vereniging van Economisten in Suriname (VES)
notes: Chairman of the Association of Economists in Suriname (VES) and university lecturer; highlighted in official state consultations that weak tax administration and failure to collect wealth taxes severely restrict Suriname's economic growth.

name: Vereniging van Economisten in Suriname
role: Professional association of economists in Suriname
notes: Suriname's leading professional economic association (VES), established in 1972, providing statutory and independent economic advice to the National Assembly and government.

name: Armand Achaibersing
role: Minister of Finance and Planning of Suriname (2020–2022)
notes: Surinamese insurer and politician; Minister of Finance and Planning (2020–2022) under President Santokhi. Declared in August 2020 that collecting and enforcing the statutory wealth tax was part of the government's economic recovery program.
